title: Velvet Matte Lipstick
description: An ultra-creamy, highly pigmented lipstick that glides on smoothly and sets into a gorgeous, long-lasting velvet matte finish. Enriched with natural oils and Vitamin E to keep your lips hydrated and soft all day.

title: Luminous Foundation
description: Achieve a flawless, radiant complexion with this buildable, medium-coverage liquid foundation. Featuring light-reflecting pigments and a lightweight feel, it provides a natural dewy finish that lasts up to 16 hours.

title: Rose Blush Palette
description: A stunning cheek palette containing four complementary blush shades ranging from soft rose to warm peach. The silky, micro-milled powders blend seamlessly into the skin for a beautiful, customizable flush of color.
